name: system-design
description: Free System Design Academy — interactive lessons, diagrams, and interview prep for system design concepts.

paragraphs: A dependency-free, static learning application that teaches system design from first principles through advanced distributed architecture. It runs entirely in the browser using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—no backend, build step, account, or framework is required.
features: 50 complete lessons across Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced levels.
16 end-to-end design projects, including URL shortening, chat, payments, search, ride sharing, video streaming, analytics, and a global multi-tenant capstone.
10 scenario exercises with immediate, answer-specific architectural feedback.
Quizzes for every lesson, including feedback for correct and incorrect choices.
Interactive architecture playground with draggable components, directional connections, labels, editing, duplication, deletion, templates, autosave, JSON import/export, and SVG export.
